scripts.start: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:prod: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:full: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "cloudflared tunnel --config config.yml run"
scripts.build: concurrently "npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend" "npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend"
